title: Romance, overseas surgeon needs customs fee wired

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: My dearest Margaret, the hospital in Yemen will not release my equipment until the customs bond is paid. Twenty thousand. Once I am home we will laugh about this over dinner.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Daniel, that is almost everything I have in checking.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: And I will return every dollar the day I land, you have my word as a surgeon and a widower. Please do not tell Priya, she already doubts me and I could not bear it. Wire it today, the bond office closes for the holiday tomorrow.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I just want you home safe.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Then send it, my love. The agent's account is in my email.

review_note: Romance scam with the overseas professional trope. New payee on WIRE, far over 3x baseline. H-01 and H-03 hold on facts; secrecy and urgency should also fire. H-07 (irreversible rail above $1,000 to a non-biller) added to allowed_rule_ids on 2026-10-24 03:40; outcome unchanged.
